name: 熏製

pages.text: 羊毛紗用於懸掛物品以進行$(thing)熏製$()。按$(item)$(k:key.use)$()即可放置羊毛紗。
熏製用於儲存$(thing)肉類$()和$(l:mechanics/dairy)乳酪$()。熏製肉類前，必須先用$(thing)滷水$()將其密封在$(thing)大桶$()中進行$(thing)滷製$()。你也可以先將其用鹽醃製。乳酪在熏製之前沒有這些要求。

To start the smoking process, add the item to the string above a firepit. The firepit must be within $(flcfg:smokingFirepitRange) blocks, directly underneath the string. The string should begin to generate some smoke if it is working. It is important to note that the firepit must only be burned with $(thing)Logs$(). Using something like $(thing)Peat$() will instantly give your food the $(thing)Disgusting$() trait!
The smoking process takes $(flcfg:smokingTicks). Happy smoking!
